result.topic_en: Notes on superfluous invariants of binary forms, on computing the characteristic function for ternary forms (in particular expressing a ternary quartic as $\varphi\psi-\chi^2$, the bitangent problem), and on extending the Cayley-Sylvester counting theorem to ternary forms.
